description: Use this when the user asks which pages go on which sheet for a booklet or a 2-up or 4-up print, how many sheets a booklet needs, or how many blank pages a booklet gets, without a file. Takes a page count from 1 to 1,000, layout booklet, 2up or 4up, and binding left or right, and returns the sheet count, blank pages added, the order per sheet side and a CSV of the full order. Does not make a PDF (use make_booklet with the file for that).

binding.description: left (default, for left-to-right books) or right (right-to-left books such as Arabic or Hebrew: the first page sits on the right).

layout.description: booklet (default: pages in fold order, 2 per sheet side, to fold and staple in the middle), 2up (2 pages per sheet side in reading order) or 4up (4 pages per sheet side).

pages.description: Number of pages in the document, 1 to 1000, e.g. 10.

name: plan_booklet
title: Plan booklet page order
